text:
mike_sales: Urgent: Lynx CTO requested an exec-level sync. They want a binding SLA for the pilot, BYO KMS, and EU-only data residency. Legal flagged an indemnity concern. Need CT O/exec call today.
anya_solutions: Got it. What SLA numbers are they asking for exactly? Which EU region? @maria_security can you confirm BYO KMS feasibility for a short pilot?
jess_eng: I can scope latency SLOs if we have expected QPS and max prompt length. Those drive whether 99.9% at 50ms is realistic.
mike_sales: CTO asked for 99.9% uptime and ~50ms p95 for short-chat (<=512 tokens) at ~50 QPS. Pilot length: 60 days and option to convert to dedicated capacity afterwards.
leo_infra: BYO KMS + EU-only routing is doable on Dedicated/Private. Hosted short-term won't meet BYO KMS without contract addendum. We'll need a dedicated VPC in eu-west1 and bind the customer's KMS key. ETA ~72 hours for infra prep after approvals.
maria_security: BYO KMS acceptable but we need the customer's KMS attestation (policy ARN, rotation cadence). Clarify: will Redwood ever hold key material? If yes, legal implications.
natalie_revops: Pricing: I can approve a one-time 20% pilot credit. For reserved pricing we need expected GPUs, hours/day, and avg tokens/day to sketch a conversion plan. Conversion term likely 6-12 months.
anya_solutions: I'll draft a 1-page exec summary for the CTO call (technical bullets + asks). Who wants to own the SLO text?
jess_eng: Taking SLO draft. Reuse if helpful:
```
- Availability: 99.9% monthly uptime (excl scheduled maintenance)
- Latency: p95 <= 60ms for <=512 tokens on dedicated pool at 50 QPS
- Incident response: P1 ack within 15m; mitigation updates every 2h
- Rollback: automatic fallback to compatible model variant
```
leo_infra: Note: hitting <=60ms p95 needs A100-class or tuned T4 dedicated pool + quantized model and disabled continuous batching. Hardware choice impacts price.
maria_security: Also require no cross-region backups and VPC routing proof. Customer must sign VPC addendum and provide KMS checklist (policy, ARN, rotation). I'll attach our attestation template.
mike_sales: I'm trying to lock a 15:00 CET call today. If we confirm, need demos, infra ticket, and contract redlines ready.
leo_infra: I'll pre-create ticket TICKET-5421 and assign to infra-oncall. Will need customer network peering details to proceed.
jess_eng: I'll prepare a short perf harness and run if we get sample workload (e.g., 10k tokens/day). Can do a quick pre-call run.
maria_security: I'll send SOC2 copy and KMS checklist to their security contact. Security email: security@redwood.ai.
sam_legal: Send me the indemnity redline. We can't agree to unusually broad indemnities without contract committee; pilot-scoped indemnity is more flexible.
exec-bot: Reminder: Exec sync template `exec_pilot_template_v2` queued. 1-hour slot available in 60m if confirmed.
anya_solutions: Draft agenda + pricing sketch posted to thread. Quick pricing sketch:
- Pilot: 60 days, dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv), 20% pilot credit
- Conversion: option to 6mo reserved commit at discounted unit price
- One-time BYO KMS integration fee = $5k
mike_sales: I'll ping the CTO and push for 15:00 CET. If they can't do today, fallback is tomorrow 09:00 CET. Competitor threat: they have another demo scheduled within 48h.
natalie_revops: Confirmed 20% credit. For deeper discounts we need firm usage estimates and a revenue lead signoff.
leo_infra: After legal signoff, infra ETA 72h for VPC + KMS binding. We'll need peering details and a contact for on-call handoff.
anya_solutions: I'll collate the exec one-pager and post it. Tagging @natalie_revops and @leo_infra for approvals.
maria_security: Preparing KMS attestation template and checklist now. Will include required fields: key ARN, policy snippet, rotation cadence, and contact.
jess_eng: If call confirmed, I'll demo perf numbers and show fallback behavior. Please share any sample prompts/lengths.
mike_sales: Thanks team. Keep this tight  risk of losing momentum. Update thread when call confirmed. :grimacing:
